The plan comparison screen is complete in `src/screens/Screen.tsx` and `src/screens/Screen.module.css`.

Notes on what I built and why:
- `node_modules` wasn't installed and I couldn't look outside the app folder, so I had no way to verify `@strata/react`/`@strata/icons`' actual component names or props. Guessing wrong would break the build, so I used semantic HTML/CSS instead, styled entirely with `--strata-*` design tokens (following the naming pattern from `app.css`) so colors, spacing, and typography still adapt correctly across brands, light/dark, and density — each declaration has a sensible fallback in case an exact token name differs.
- Three mock plans (Starter, Growth — recommended, Scale), each with a name, one-line summary, and six shared features marked included/excluded via inline SVG check/dash icons (with screen-reader-only "Included"/"Not included" text).
- A Monthly/Yearly segmented toggle switches all three prices; yearly also shows the per-month equivalent.
- Layout uses CSS logical properties (`inset-inline-start`, `padding-inline`, `margin-inline-start`, etc.) throughout so it mirrors correctly for the `ar-AE` RTL locale.

I can't run the app to visually verify, per your instructions — worth a manual check in the browser across brands/schemes/locales when you get a chance.
